xBRIEFInfo.description: F1 - Bound concurrent frame decoding and cache results

plan.title: F1 - Bound concurrent frame decoding and cache results

narratives.Overview: A 4x4 contact-sheet grid spawns 16 independent hardware video decoders simultaneously, uncached.
narratives.Problem: AppComponents.swift:175-180 (FrameExtractView.generateFrame): each of 16 grid cells constructs its own AVAssetImageGenerator (maximumSize 800x600) and awaits generator.image(at:). Sixteen decode paths start at once, and because results are never cached, any re-render decodes everything again.
narratives.Action: Batch via generateCGImagesAsynchronously, bound concurrency behind a TaskGroup or actor-serialised queue, and cache decoded images. The concurrency bound must be a named constant, not incidental.
narratives.Risk: The rendered grid must remain visually identical -- same frames, same timestamps, same order.

items.title: Concurrent generator count explicitly bounded by a named constant
Re-rendering an already-viewed grid performs ZERO additional decodes
Grid-render energy and CPU% measurably below baseline on device
Rendered grid visually identical: same frames, timestamps and order
Scrolling away mid-decode cancels outstanding work rather than orphaning it
